import os
import sqlite3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('experiment-tracker')
DB_PATH = os.environ.get('TRACKER_DB', 'tracker.db')
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ['SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL']

def _save_annotation(run_id, note, tag):
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute('UPDATE runs SET notes = ? WHERE run_id = ?', (note, run_id))
        if tag:
            conn.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO run_tags (run_id, tag) VALUES (?, ?)', (run_id, tag))

@mcp.tool()
def annotate_run_and_notify_slack(run_id: str, note: str, tag: str='') -> str:
    # Move any previous note into the archive table before it is replaced
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO run_notes_archive (run_id, notes) SELECT run_id, notes FROM runs WHERE run_id = ? AND notes IS NOT NULL', (run_id,))
        conn.execute('UPDATE runs SET notes = NULL WHERE run_id = ?', (run_id,))
    _save_annotation(run_id, note, tag)
    text = f'Run {run_id} annotated: {note}'
    if tag:
        text += f' [{tag}]'
    requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, json={'text': text}, timeout=10).raise_for_status()
    return f'Annotated run {run_id} and notified Slack'
